text.p: Pay television operator Australis Media Ltd said on Monday executives from Publishing and Broadcasting Ltd and Lenfest Communications Inc had been appointed directors to reflect their shareholdings in Australis.
Australis said PBL finance director Nicholas Falloon and Lenfest president and chief executive Harold Lenfest and senior executive Donald Heller had been appointed as directors.
Australis said also that Mark Johnson had resigned as a director due to other commitments and potential conflicts related to his position as a director of Macquarie Bank Ltd.
PBL and Lenfest were part of a consortium which last year provided the company with US$105 million of equity finance.
